Major 0.8 release: workbench-first shell, embedded Pi agent, and pixel-accurate desktop layout. Projects and chats persist across restarts; switching projects no longer kills background agents. Chat runs on Pi exclusively — OpenCode is removed from the product path.

### Workbench
- The left sidebar is a **workbench tree**: open projects stay listed with their chats underneath. Switching chats changes the file tree, library, and panels without stopping the previous project’s agent.
- Quit and reopen restores your last project and chat tabs. The default project can leave the workbench like any other folder; add it back from Recents (marked Default).
- Drag project rows to reorder; filter chats by Workbench or Updated; archived chats live in a footer view. Project rows use folder marks — custom project icons are gone.
- New storage layout: sessions in `~/.prismnext/sessions/`, per-project libraries and worktrees under `~/.prismnext/projects/`, project metadata in `<project>/.workbench/`. Legacy paper-side `.prismnext/` is not written.
- A background chat waiting for approval no longer steals focus — the sidebar marks the row and a title-bar chip names the project. Stop a background chat from its row only.
- The Welcome / environment page is removed. Opening lands on a real default project at `Documents/PrismNext`.

### Chat & agent
- Session rows show **waiting, running, unread, and read** states. Right-click to pin, rename, pick an icon (shared compact picker with Teams), mark unread, archive, or copy session ID / branch / markdown transcript.
- **Embedded Pi** is the only chat runtime: send, history, permissions, Plan mode, Task delegation, MCP, skills, and provider catalog all go through the product `agent:*` API. OpenCode binaries and transcripts are gone.
- Conversation UI follows Pi’s turn model — thinking/tool folds, undo/rollback, permission cards above the composer, and context compress with a “show earlier” bar.
- Empty homepage composer includes a **project picker** (same panel as Workbench Add). After the first reply, PrismNext asks the model for a short title.
- Smart shell permissions: harmless commands auto-run; deny-list commands are refused; everything else asks once with a consistent preview.
- Provider catalog, context ring (live window + spend), vision attachments, figure/TikZ drawing skills, and standalone vs paper compile paths are fully wired on Pi.

### Shell
- **Pixel shell**: Left / Content / Right use remembered pixel widths — Content shrinks first, rails ease toward 280px, RightArea maximizes after Content hits 400px + 140px travel. Sash drag is 1:1; toggles ease over 220ms.
- Folding the left sidebar no longer replays RightArea’s open animation. Desktop glass applies to the left rail only (Electron 43 vibrancy / Windows Mica); title bars stay opaque.
- Customize visible **workspace modules** from a left-sidebar context menu. RightArea shortcuts: ⌥⌘B split, ⌃⌘B maximize.
- Settings detail width persists; Back sits above the category list. macOS traffic lights align to the 38px title bar.

### Browser, literature & logs
- Browser address bar suggests bookmarks, recents, URLs, and search; in-page links and refresh work again on Electron 43.
- Library no longer double-lists papers on first open.
- Application Logs loads the full ring buffer, supports row selection/copy, and records compile jobs, agent host events, project/git failures, and IPC crashes — without chat text or secrets.

### Website
- Privacy Policy, Terms, Open Source Notices, and Security pages — linked from the site footer and Settings → About (opens in the system browser).
- Legal copy matches the product: no telemetry, no PrismNext cloud, Pi (not OpenCode) as the chat runtime, Tectonic as the bundled engine.

### Under the hood
- Main process reorganized into domain folders; renderer uses `lib/desktop-api/` ports only.
- TypeScript 7 type-checking, Vite 7 / electron-vite 5, Electron 43 runtime.
- See [`changelog/series/0.8.x.md`](../series/0.8.x.md) for the full development log.
